> Minecraft Java snapshot: `1.21.8`  
> Protocol version: `772`

[![](https://minecraft.wiki/images/Information_icon.svg?15c1c)](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Information_icon.svg "File:Information icon.svg")

This feature is exclusive to [*Java Edition*](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition "Java Edition").

[![](https://minecraft.wiki/images/thumb/Banner_beta.png/644px-Banner_beta.png?e9ca7)](https://minecraft.wiki/w/File:Banner_beta.png)

*[Java Edition](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition "Java Edition")* is one of the two updated versions of *Minecraft* which require a paid account to download, update and play. Most of the new development projects focus on either creating entirely new programs from scratch that interoperate with *Minecraft* (such as a bot or server) or modding projects that wrap the client or server and provide bug fixes, new features and enhancements to existing features.

### Documentation

There are ongoing efforts to keep reverse engineered documentation updated, but it isn't as easy as it sounds. The protocol generally changes slightly with each release, and both the Client and Server classes get rearranged on each release. Below are links to the current documentation segments, which **may or may not be completely up to date**.

### Tools & Mods

- [Clients](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorial:Programs_and_editors/Client_reimplementations "Tutorial:Programs and editors/Client reimplementations") - third-party *Java Edition* clients
- [Servers](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Server_List "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Server List") - third-party *Java Edition* servers
- [Libraries](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Library_List "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Library List") - libraries to interface with Minecraft data files or network protocols
- [Utilities](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Utility_List "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Utility List") - tools that interface with a client, server, or data files, such as proxies, bots, or inventory editors
- [Wrappers](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Wrapper_List "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Wrapper List") - mods that override features in the client or server
- [Generators](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Generator_List "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Generator List") - tools that extract data from Mojang to a readable format
- [Decompilers](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Decompiler_List "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Decompiler List") - tools for decompiling *Java Edition*
- [Burger](https://github.com/mcdevs/Burger/) - a tool that generates information for arbitrary *Java Edition* versions
  - [Pokechu22](https://minecraft.wiki/w/User:Pokechu22 "User:Pokechu22")'s [fork](https://github.com/Pokechu22/Burger) - where new version development is mostly done
  - [Burger Vitrine](https://pokechu22.github.io/BurgerWebViewer/) - shows differences in data and protocol between arbitrary versions
  - [PAaaS](https://github.com/Matsv/PAaaS) - shows differences in protocol and sounds for newer versions (1.8 and above)
- [Code Snippets](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Code_Snippets "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Code Snippets")
